decisions.reason: Although an accelerator program is less central than the firm's machinery platforms, it still builds on its advisory capabilities, partnerships and related knowledge, so a growing R&D-active firm is more likely to retain it than to exit quickly.

Despite being somewhat more distant from the firm's core equipment base than its plant products, it is presented as a flagship and the firm's own R&D and recycling expertise raise its capacity to learn and improve it rather than withdraw it.

This decontamination plant is close to the firm's established waste-treatment technology base and was highlighted as a strategic focus, making continuation very likely for a knowledge-rich, expanding German machinery firm.

A mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core modular recycling know-how and manufacturing capabilities especially well, so absorptive-capacity logic points strongly toward keeping and refining it.
